caption: A loose wire in an open junction box shorts against the box, and a flash and puff of smoke come from the spot.

sa.check: An open junction box with wires inside.
A loose wire touches the box.
A flash comes from the spot.
A puff of smoke comes from the spot.
The flash comes first and the smoke follows.

pc.expect: The flash is brief at the point where the wire meets the box, and is gone; the smoke appears after the flash and rises; the wire does not glow afterwards.
pc.fail: The wire glows on after the flash; or the flash stays lit at the spot for the rest of the clip; or smoke rises before the flash; or the smoke shrinks back into the box.

pc.expect: One box with its wires; the wires stay continuous and in the box; the flash leaves nothing glowing behind.
pc.fail: A wire vanishes or a new wire appears; or the box vanishes or duplicates; or a glowing dot stays at the spot after the flash; or a wire's end detaches and floats.

pc.expect: The smoke rises from the spot and spreads; any spark fragments fall and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: The smoke sinks from the box and pools below; or hangs as a fixed shape; or sparks rise and gather above the box; or sparks lie glowing on the floor for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The wire is flexible and lies where it fell; the box is a rigid metal or plastic housing that keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The wire stands rigid like a rod; or the box bends or ripples at the flash; or the box melts and sags.

pc.expect: The wire touches the inside of the box and stays inside it; nothing passes through the box's walls.
pc.fail: The wire passes through the box's wall; or the box sinks into the wall behind it; or the wires merge into one; or the box changes shape.

pc.expect: The wires' insulation colours, the box's finish away from the spot and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: A wire changes colour; or the box changes colour away from the spot; or the wall changes colour.
